headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings. Never use Inter for headings. Use font-black for maximum impact on primary metrics.

body.usage: Use for standard UI text, paragraphs, and descriptions.

mono.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all SKUs, Order IDs, Financial Data (GMV, Profit), Inventory Counts, and uppercase labels.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Dark Mode)

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (MODE B) - The Technical Look
layouts.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between widgets. Use generous p-6 or p-8 for internal card padding. Maintain high density without feeling cramped.
layouts.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar for module navigation (Dashboard, Orders, Inventory, Stores).
layouts.dashboard: F-pattern layout. Top row: 3-4 headline KPIs (GMV, Total Orders, Net Profit). Middle: Store performance comparison chart (col-span-full or col-span-2).
layouts.surfaces: GRID BORDERS strategy. Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items use border-r border-b border-white/10. No floating cards.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-white/10). No soft shadows. Use sharp edges (rounded-none or max 4px rounded-sm). Tactical minimalism.
visual_enhancers.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color and lighten surface (e.g., hover:bg-white/5). Focus states must use Volt Blue ring.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimal. Use micro-interactions for feedback. Smooth state changes (transition-colors duration-200). NO universal transitions.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm). High saturation accent blocks. Volt Blue (bg-[#007AFF] text-white) for primary CTA (Batch Print). border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5 for secondary.
components.cards: Cardless look or flat rectangular. border border-white/10. NO drop shadows. Use inner glow (shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]) for subtle depth.
components.tables: High density. JetBrains Mono for data cells. Explicit hover states for rows. Left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. Sticky headers with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0A0A]/80.
components.inputs: Flat. bg-transparent border border-white/20 focus:border-[#007AFF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF] text-white.
components.badges: Square or slight rounding (rounded-sm). 1px border. Used for Order Status and Platform tags.
components.modals: Solid background (#0A0A0A) with 1px border-white/10. Dimmer overlay (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm). Never use muddy transparent backgrounds.

icons_and_assets.icon_usage: Weight 'regular' or 'duotone'. Use for sidebar navigation, metric icons, and action buttons. Keep consistent sizing.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Primary text must be pure white or very light gray.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

charts.styling: Dark mode optimized. Grid lines should be stroke-white/5. Tooltips must match the dark UI surface with border-white/10 and Solid Background. No default white tooltips.

instructions_to_main_agent: Run 'yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts sonner' for dependencies.
Follow the 'Tactical Dark Mode' aesthetic strictly. The app background must be #0A0A0A.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings. Setup 'Chivo' for headings, 'Satoshi' for body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for numerical data.
Ensure all tables (Order Hub, Inventory) are dense and use mono-spaced fonts for IDs, SKUs, and prices.
For the Store comparison chart, use recharts and style it minimally without heavy fills. Use crisp lines.
Modal for 'Add Inbound Stock' should use a solid dark surface with 1px border. Calculate final base cost dynamically.
Add data-testid to all buttons, links, and forms.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or sticky headers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties instead.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for layout, but keep tables high-density.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays can be used to break flat digital feel.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Override Shadcn default Vercel-look with our brutalist overrides.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
